UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile and cross-device Gmail synchronization metadata

id.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

deletedActivityIds.description: Bounded list (max 200) of deleted activity IDs for cross-device deletion sync

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial profile creation

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest cloud synchronization

ActivityRecord.title: ActivityRecord
ActivityRecord.description: Recorded cycling or running GPS activity with route coordinates, kilometer splits, and telemetry metrics

startTime.description: Activity start epoch timestamp in milliseconds

endTime.description: Activity end epoch timestamp in milliseconds

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client modification epoch timestamp in milliseconds

stats.description: Sanitized real-time and summary telemetry metrics

points.description: Bounded array (max 1800) of GPS route coordinates and telemetry points

splits.description: Bounded array (max 500) of per-kilometer split metrics

gpsQuality.description: GPS signal quality and completeness summary

interruptions.description: Bounded array (max 100) of tracking interruption logs

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial cloud upload

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest cloud update

/users/{userId}.description: Stores verified Gmail user profile and cross-device synchronization metadata

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Stores synchronized cycling and running GPS activities for the authenticated Gmail account
